acceptance_gate.condition: harness_smoke_passed true with trainable_param_count>0 and lora_attach_path recorded, OR an honest blocked_* verdict

field_principles.harness_smoke_passed: BARE bool: B2's gate compares this raw value (gated-fields-must-be-bare); true iff LoRA attached with >0 trainable params AND 1 training step ran AND loss was finite on the fixture.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. A passing harness smoke OR an honest blocked_* is COMPLETE -- B2 gates on the smoke so a broken harness surfaces HERE, not as another failed training run.
field_principles.lora_attach_path: Which fix worked (standard AutoModelForCausalLM target_modules, or wrapper .linear patch) -- the load-bearing diagnostic so B2 and future runs do not re-hit the Gemma4ClippableLinear rejection.
field_principles.model_specs: The NON-Qwen base + the working LoRA config (target_modules that attached); required methodology + the recipe B2 reuses.
field_principles.random_seed: Determinism precondition; torch + LoRA init seeded so the smoke is reproducible.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash of the fixture + LoRA config; lets a third party confirm the same harness inputs.
field_principles.trainable_param_count: BARE int >0 -- proves LoRA actually attached (the .390 failure was 0 attach); a zero here means the fix did not take.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: BARE bool=true -- HONEST: the eventual reward is the execution oracle (RLVR/RLEF reward axis), NOT a moat claim (Circularity Discipline).

honest_verdict_principle: Terminal-prefixed. A passing harness smoke OR an honest blocked_* is COMPLETE -- B2 gates on the smoke so a broken harness surfaces HERE, not as another failed training run.
